intro: B2: the health system as a topic for discussion — pharmacy, free healthcare, prevention, telemedicine. We argue, compare and propose.
speaking.0.promptUa: Describe the illustration and comment on the situation. Say what role the pharmacist plays and whether medicines should be available without a prescription in ordinary shops.
speaking.0.phrases.1.ua: Pharmacists play a key role in…
speaking.0.phrases.2.ua: On the other hand, there is a risk that…
speaking.0.tips.0: At B2 the description is followed by an **assessment of the role/problem** — don't stop at «widzę starszą panią».
speaking.0.tips.1: **Coraz więcej osób…, co może być…** — the construction «which may be…» (co + zdanie) enriches your language.
speaking.0.tips.2: Finish with advice or your own position — that's the «twoja opinia» point.
speaking.1.promptUa: State your opinion on the thesis: «Access to a doctor should be completely free for everyone». Justify it, refer to your own experience and take opponents' arguments into account.
speaking.1.phrases.0.ua: I believe that…, although I'm not sure whether…
speaking.1.phrases.1.ua: From my own experience I know that…
speaking.1.phrases.3.ua: Provided that the system works efficiently.
speaking.1.tips.0: **Pod warunkiem, że…** — the phrase «provided that» ends a balanced position perfectly.
speaking.1.tips.1: Don't stick to extremes: «chociaż nie jestem pewna, czy…» sounds wiser than «I'm right».
speaking.1.tips.2: Use facts you know from life in Poland — that's an argument from personal experience.
speaking.2.promptUa: You have been waiting for a doctor's appointment for an hour and a half after the scheduled time. You are talking to a receptionist. Express your dissatisfaction, state your expectations and decide how to resolve the situation.
speaking.2.phrases.0.ua: I would like to know why…
speaking.2.phrases.2.ua: I would like to submit a written complaint.
speaking.2.tips.1: **Rozumiem…, ale…** — a two-step reaction shows respect for the other person and firmness.
speaking.2.tips.2: At the end always agree the next step (deadline, form, confirmation).
writing.0.promptUa: You need a medical certificate for your employer after a clinic visit. Write to the clinic: give the visit details, explain what the certificate is for and ask them to e-mail it by a certain date.
writing.0.phrases.0.ua: I kindly ask for the issue of…
writing.0.phrases.1.ua: I would be grateful for sending…
writing.0.phrases.3.ua: Thank you in advance for your help.
writing.0.tips.0: **Byłabym wdzięczna za + accusative/verbal noun** (for przesłanie) — a formal and polite style.
writing.0.tips.1: Give the deadline precisely: «w ciągu trzech dni roboczych» — it's both courtesy and clarity.
writing.1.promptUa: Write a blog post on the topic: «A healthy lifestyle — fashion or necessity?». State your opinion, describe the trends you observe, point out the risks of overdoing it and finish with advice for readers.
writing.1.phrases.0.ua: In recent years more and more people…
writing.1.phrases.1.ua: However, one must beware of excess.
writing.1.phrases.3.ua: That's why I advise readers to…
writing.1.tips.0: **co prowadzi do + genitive** — a handy link «which leads to…» that builds a complex sentence with a consequence.
writing.1.tips.1: A comparison-metaphor («jak maraton, a nie jak sprint») is memorable and shows stylistic range.
writing.1.tips.2: Don't forget your own experience — it makes the text credible and covers a separate point.
listening.0.intro: A radio interview about prevention. Listen and choose the correct answers.
grammar.0.intro: Complex structures: relative clauses, temporal conjunctions, prepositions of cause.
grammar.0.questions.2.why: **z powodu** + genitive — a cause (negative); «dzięki» — positive, «mimo» — despite.
grammar.0.questions.3.why: «dwa razy» — 2–4 + nominative plural: dwa, trzy, cztery razy.
